title: skills: teach `RuntimeBuildIssue.userMessage` in the api and i18n skills
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` card of PR #34513 (Part of #32984, `Metadata-protocol: added`), handed to this seat by seat repo:objectstack#1 (mailbox comment 6933723686; PR state comment 6933691752). Dedupe: `RuntimeBuildIssue userMessage skill`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p2 · `domain:skills` · `pm:blocked`, Blocked-by #32984

## 维护者速读

- 现象:#32984 Q1 让运行时构建检查的每条问题都带一句按用户语言写好的 `userMessage`(8 种问题、11 种语言)。教 API 和 i18n 的两个技能还没讲这个字段，也没讲界面应该显示它，而不是显示原始的 `message`。
- 为什么要修：技能不教，AI 写界面时还会把面向开发者的原始报错直接给用户看。
- 需要你做的：无(落地时按受管面照常审批)。

## Change

After PR #34513 merges, teach `RuntimeBuildIssue.userMessage` in `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` (what it carries, and that a client shows it, not `message`) and in `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` (how its locale is chosen). Take the wording from the merged spec and ADR-0038 amendment; do not restate it in a third place. Add one eval where the agent renders a build issue to a user and must use `userMessage`.

## Done when

Both skills teach it, and the eval passes.

Blocked-by: #32984
